worlds.readme:
server

This world belongs to one computer/user instance. Its root is this folder:
.rab/worlds/server under that user's home.

settings.json owns its identity, title, description, creation date and path
declarations. The world holds shared information that projects can refer to.
Projects keep their own records under .rab/projects; creating a world does
not move them or make copies of their source folders.

paths starts as an empty array. Beacon discovery and scanner visibility
are separate capabilities; creating this world does not start a scanner.

tools.title: Cross-Examine All Defensive Guards
tools.description: Runs isolated known-bad and known-good synthetic fixtures through every network, security, and hosting defensive audit Tool and passes only when each guard catches its bad fixture and accepts its good fixture.

tools.title: Check Authorized Brain Remote Access
tools.description: Checks one explicitly supplied Brain endpoint from the machine running Magic Box. It tests unauthenticated access first and can retry with a credential loaded from an environment variable, without returning Brain content.

tools.title: Cross-Examine Hosting Guards
tools.description: Runs isolated known-bad and known-good synthetic fixtures through every defensive hosting audit Tool and reports whether each guard behaves as expected.

tools.title: Check Authorized HTTP Boundary
tools.description: Checks one explicit HTTP(S) endpoint from the machine running Magic Box. It records unauthenticated behavior and can optionally retry using a credential loaded only from an environment variable.

tools.title: Cross-Examine Network Guards
tools.description: Runs isolated known-bad and known-good synthetic fixtures through every defensive network audit Tool and reports whether each guard behaves as expected.

tools.title: Cross-Examine Security Guards
tools.description: Runs isolated known-bad and known-good synthetic fixtures through every defensive code-security audit Tool and reports whether each guard behaves as expected.

tools.title: Check Authorized TCP Reachability
tools.description: Tests one explicitly supplied host and one explicitly supplied TCP port from the machine running Magic Box. It does not enumerate ports or scan ranges.

tools.title: Check Authorized TLS Boundary
tools.description: Performs one TLS handshake to an explicit authorized host and port, reporting protocol, certificate metadata, and certificate validation state without sending application payloads.

tools.title: Audit Content Security Policy Evidence
tools.description: Catalogs CSP configuration evidence in application and hosting files, or reports that CSP was not detected locally without claiming an external host or CDN lacks it.

tools.title: Audit Production Debug Controls
tools.description: Finds explicit debug, test-endpoint, or authentication-bypass controls that survive into deployment-bound code.

tools.title: Audit Client Production Source Maps
tools.description: Reports source-map artifacts present in deployment outputs and records whether original source text is embedded.

tools.title: Audit Package Lockfile Consistency
tools.description: Checks for a lockfile and statically compares declared dependency specs with supported lockfile root metadata when that can be proven.

tools.title: Audit Hosting Environment Manifests
tools.description: Finds sensitive or infrastructure-oriented manifests inside deployment payloads while distinguishing true credential artifacts from review-only server configuration.

tools.title: Audit Production Bundle Minification
tools.description: Reviews large deployment JavaScript and CSS bundles for likely missing minification as a performance concern, not a security boundary.

tools.title: Index project folders
tools.description: Writes a bounded local folder-ID index with parent IDs and coverage; audited input remains untouched.

tools.title: Investigate Class Impact
tools.description: Inspect where one exact class token is defined and assigned, preserving source evidence, dynamic gaps and possible change impact.

tools.title: Inspect Generated Code Safety
tools.description: Chains generated-file/upload audits to map filesystem write sinks, user-controlled filenames, FormData handling, executable source writes, SVG handling, public upload serving, generated directories, provenance markers, and input-derived path joins.

tools.title: Inspect Local Security Surface
tools.description: Chains database, FTS5, background-process, container, bind-address, LAN, and admin-route audits into one deterministic local security surface report.

tools.title: Inspect Theme Usage
tools.description: Builds a cross-reference report of theme tokens, CSS variables, class names, CSS class definitions, component definitions, component usage, and aggregate counts by chaining existing audit Tools.

tools.title: Audit Permissive CORS Policies
tools.description: Finds wildcard CORS configuration and records whether nearby development-environment guard evidence is present instead of assuming the policy is exploitable.

tools.title: Audit Docker Infrastructure Port Routing
tools.description: Scans Docker Compose mappings and Dockerfile EXPOSE declarations for explicit container port topology.

tools.title: Audit Management Route Protection
tools.description: Catalogs administrative, debug, dashboard, status, health, metrics, and internal route definitions and reports whether authorization middleware evidence is present in the route call.

tools.title: Audit Express Server Sockets
tools.description: Identifies runtime service entry points opening HTTP listeners through explicit .listen(port) calls.

tools.title: Audit Public Network Interface Bindings
tools.description: Finds server listener calls that explicitly bind to wildcard interfaces such as 0.0.0.0 or :: so externally reachable service surfaces can be reviewed.

tools.title: Audit Native HTTP Server Listeners
tools.description: Tracks native Node.js HTTP/HTTPS server instances that bind listening sockets.

tools.title: Audit Cleartext Infrastructure Protocols
tools.description: Catalogs explicit http:// and ws:// endpoints in code and configuration, classifying loopback versus non-loopback usage for defensive review.

tools.title: Audit WebSocket Server Port Sockets
tools.description: Finds ws or socket.io server constructors that explicitly allocate incoming WebSocket ports.

tools.title: Run audit over folder IDs
tools.description: Runs a declared direct-folder audit over all or selected paths in a saved folder index with bounded results and supervised time limits.

tools.title: Audit Missing Client Cookie Security Flags
tools.description: Finds cookie creation calls missing httpOnly or secure hardening flags.

tools.title: Audit Hardcoded JWT Verification Secrets
tools.description: Flags inline literal secrets passed directly to JWT sign or verify calls without echoing secret material.

tools.title: Audit Hardcoded Private Identity Assets
tools.description: Discovers embedded private-key PEM headers while redacting private key material from reports.

tools.title: Audit Unsafe Object Merging Protocols
tools.description: Finds recursive dynamic object assignment patterns without an obvious prototype-key guard.

tools.title: Audit Catastrophic Regular Expression Engines
tools.description: Flags regex patterns with nested quantifiers that require ReDoS review.

tools.title: Audit Operating System Shell Invocations
tools.description: Finds dynamic shell command construction and spawn calls that explicitly enable a shell.

tools.title: Audit Unparameterized Database Queries
tools.description: Finds SQL execution sinks receiving interpolated templates or concatenated query text.

tools.title: Audit Broken Security Protocol Constraints
tools.description: Flags explicit TLS verification disablement and obsolete minimum protocol constraints.

tools.title: New Audit Project

tools.title: Scaffolding Cleanup Pass
tools.description: Removes only RRAABBIITT construction-seat attributes and marker comments from one already-built artifact. It does not resolve seats, infer values, or modify application content.

tools.title: List Construction Seats
tools.description: Lists RRAABBIITT construction-seat markers in one artifact without modifying the file.

tools.title: Review Proposed Code

tools.title: Review Code Atoms

tools.title: Review Code Conventions
tools.description: Checks submitted JavaScript or TypeScript for exact plural collection to singular map callback names using the existing conventions auditor.

tools.title: Review Code Grids
tools.description: Checks pasted JSX or TSX for Grid to Flex to Grid ancestry, using the existing grid continuity auditor.

tools.title: Review Code Guards
tools.description: Checks pasted JavaScript or TypeScript with the existing Bag/collection guards and prop-renaming auditors.

tools.title: Review and Write New File
tools.description: Reruns every available code review and creates a new file in the selected project only if all applicable checks pass. Requires explicit confirmation; existing files are never overwritten.

tools.title: Add CSS State to Atom

tools.title: Food Process Residence Time

tools.description: Records a human food dislike as a project-scoped preference, explicitly separate from allergy safety authority.

tools.title: Start Kitchen Project
tools.description: Starts or resumes Kitchen/Baking project context, asks who is cooking for, and requires explicit allergy status before safety claims.

tools.title: Build Kitchen Receipt
tools.description: Builds an explicit BEFORE / OPERATION / RETURNED / AFTER / VERDICT transition receipt for Kitchen work.

tools.title: Check Recipe Constraints
tools.description: Checks recipe candidate conflicts against scoped allergies and human exclusions without promoting starter metadata into safety proof.

tools.title: Check Recipe Inventory
tools.description: Checks whether inventory can be evaluated for a recipe and returns UNRESOLVED when the starter index lacks authored ingredients.

tools.title: Filter Recipes
tools.description: Filters starter recipe candidates conservatively using project allergy constraints while leaving unauthored ingredient, equipment, time, and cross-contact checks unresolved.

tools.title: Find Recipe
tools.description: Finds recipe candidates in the starter Kitchen recipe index without inventing unauthored recipe content.

tools.title: List Recipes
tools.description: Lists the starter Kitchen recipe index by query, category, cuisine, or protein. The index is a corpus seed, not safety authority.

tools.title: Check Measured Temperature
tools.description: Checks a supplied measurement against the applicable packaged home-cooking temperature/rest reference and returns a scoped verification receipt.

tools.title: Get Kitchen Safety Reference
tools.description: Returns the packaged authority/provenance record for consumer, allergen, retail, or industrial reference metadata.

tools.title: Get Home Cooking Safety Target
tools.description: Looks up a packaged U.S. home-cooking temperature/rest target by explicit reference scope. Generic consumer targets are not industrial process authority.

tools.title: Verify Recipe Ready
tools.description: Verifies whether a recipe candidate has enough deterministic evidence to be executable; starter-index-only recipes remain unresolved.

tools.title: Add Project Path
tools.description: Adds or updates a named path in the saved project's settings and attaches it to the shared listener.

tools.title: Copy Component
tools.description: Copies a component artifact into another project folder and can rename the copied component.

tools.title: Copy File
tools.description: Copies a project file into another project folder without overwriting an existing destination.

tools.title: Delete Component
tools.description: Deletes one component artifact after explicit confirmation.

tools.title: Delete File
tools.description: Deletes one project file after explicit confirmation.

tools.title: Move Component
tools.description: Moves a component artifact into another project folder while preserving project containment.

tools.title: Move File
tools.description: Moves a project file into another project folder while preserving project containment.

tools.title: Remove Project Path
tools.description: Removes a named path from saved project settings and detaches its shared listener without deleting source files.

tools.title: Rename Component
tools.description: Renames a component artifact in place and rewrites the component identifier inside the renamed artifact.

tools.title: Rename File
tools.description: Renames a project file in place without overwriting an existing path.

tools.title: Save Component As
tools.description: Copies a component to a new component name and rewrites the copied component identifier.

tools.title: Save File As
tools.description: Copies a file to a new name in a selected project folder.

tools.title: Add Attribute
tools.description: Adds a static attribute to a resolved DOM target without modifying dynamic JSX attribute expressions.

tools.title: Add Class
tools.description: Attaches one or more class tokens to a component DOM target. Resolves a component name or file/path, defaults to the highest-level rendered DOM element, and can target one or all matching data-area or element nodes.

tools.title: Add Data Area
tools.description: Adds a data-area attribute to a resolved DOM target.

tools.title: Add DOM Element
tools.description: Adds a native DOM element inside a resolved component target. Defaults to adding a div inside the highest-level rendered DOM element and can target one or all matching data-area or element nodes while optionally assigning a class.

tools.title: Add Scroll Wrapper
tools.description: Wraps one exact React DOM target in a div carrying the canonical scroll-y utility class and an optional construction seat.

tools.title: Apply Grid Layout
tools.description: Applies a known grid topology to a React page/component root or exact nested construction target and creates addressable data-area construction seats using existing DOM edit Tools.

tools.title: Set Scroll Y
tools.description: Adds the canonical scroll-y utility class to one exact React DOM target.

tools.title: Change Attribute
tools.description: Changes an existing static attribute value on a resolved DOM target. Dynamic expressions are refused rather than guessed.

tools.title: Change Class
tools.description: Updates an exact class token on a component DOM target by replacing it with another class token. Resolves a component name or file/path, defaults to the highest-level rendered DOM element, and can target one or all matching data-area or element nodes.

tools.title: Change Data Area
tools.description: Changes the data-area value on a resolved DOM target.

tools.title: Count Components
tools.description: Counts React component declarations in the loaded project or supplied folder.

tools.title: Count Hooks
tools.description: Counts all React hook calls in the loaded project or supplied folder.

tools.title: Count State Hooks
tools.description: Counts React state hooks by scanning native useState calls in the loaded project.

tools.title: Count useEffect Hooks
tools.description: Counts React useEffect hook calls in the loaded project.

tools.title: Find Hooks
tools.description: Finds all React hook calls in the loaded project or supplied folder.

tools.title: Find State Hooks
tools.description: Finds React state hooks by locating native useState calls in the loaded project.

tools.title: Find useEffect Hooks
tools.description: Finds React useEffect hook calls in the loaded project.

tools.title: Find Hook
tools.description: Finds the first matching React hook occurrence in a project folder.

tools.title: State Hook Stamp
tools.description: Creates a reusable React state hook backed by the native useState API and leaves an explicit extension seat in the generated hook.

tools.title: useEffect Stamp
tools.description: Creates a reusable React effect hook backed by the native useEffect API with explicit body and dependency seats for later Stamps.

tools.title: Insert Component Into Area
tools.description: Inserts a React component into one exact construction seat or named data-area and adds its deterministic relative import.

tools.title: Move DOM Element
tools.description: Moves one selected DOM element/subtree inside another target in the same component while refusing self/descendant moves.

tools.title: Remove Attribute
tools.description: Removes an existing static attribute from a resolved DOM target. Dynamic expressions are refused rather than guessed.

tools.title: Remove Class
tools.description: Detaches an exact class token from a component DOM target. Resolves a component name or file/path, defaults to the highest-level rendered DOM element, and can target one or all matching data-area or element nodes.

tools.title: Remove Data Area
tools.description: Removes the data-area attribute from a resolved DOM target.

tools.title: Remove DOM Element
tools.description: Removes the selected DOM element and its subtree. Defaults to the component root only when no selector is supplied.

tools.title: Replace DOM Element
tools.description: Changes the selected DOM tag name while preserving its attributes and children.

tools.title: Wrap DOM Element
tools.description: Wraps the selected DOM element/subtree in a new native wrapper element with optional class and data-area.

tools.title: Check Control-Plane Language
tools.description: Checks direct, mentioned and negated path-change language so descriptive text is not promoted into control-plane write authority.

tools.title: Check Control-Plane Moves
tools.description: Actively verifies Tool/Stamp path mutation confirmation, traversal, collision, stable-ID preservation, PATHS update and post-move resolution in an isolated House copy.

tools.title: Check DOM Write Boundaries
tools.description: Builds an isolated project symlink fixture and verifies DOM mutation Tools cannot edit a file that resolves outside the loaded project.

tools.title: Check HTTP Boundaries
tools.description: Actively probes the local workbench HTTP boundary for token, Origin, Host, hidden-route, path traversal, stale revision, replay, receipt and malformed-body enforcement.

tools.title: Check Local Network Binding
tools.description: Starts an isolated ephemeral workbench and verifies the server is bound only to IPv4 loopback rather than a wildcard/LAN interface.

tools.title: Check PATHS Registry Guards
tools.description: Builds an isolated malicious PATHS fixture and verifies that absolute/dot-segment escape paths are rejected before Tool resolution.

tools.title: Check Project Override Containment
tools.description: Builds an isolated project override symlink fixture and verifies that a project PATHS Tool cannot escape the loaded project through a symlink.

tools.title: Check Workbench Security
tools.description: Runs the complete bounded local Magic Box security verification suite against isolated fixtures and a loopback-only ephemeral server.

tools.title: New Action Atom
tools.description: Creates a tag-neutral CSS skin for interactive elements, including navigation links and controls, with hover, active, persistent is-active, focus and disabled states plus a React link demo.

tools.title: New Component
tools.description: Creates a structural React component with an optional canonical grid and class atoms resolved before any files are written.

tools.title: New Container Atom
tools.description: Creates a reusable CSS container skin scaffold with inset and float surface hooks, metadata and a React demo. Components own layout.

tools.title: New Dashboard
tools.description: dashboard

tools.title: New Effect Atom
tools.description: Creates a named CSS effect token alias from an existing float or inset preset, preserving its elevation-token dependency and atom metadata.

tools.title: New Grid Atom
tools.description: Creates a named CSS grid definition from an existing grid preset using data-grid and data-area selectors, retaining its area names and track topology.

tools.title: New Page
tools.description: page

tools.title: New React Project
tools.description: Creates a RAB React project at the supplied path using the built-in project template.

tools.title: New Sub Component
tools.description: Creates a structural React component with an optional canonical grid and class atoms resolved before any files are written.

tools.title: Add Beacon Manifest
tools.description: Creates an empty beacon-owned manifest beside an existing beacon.json, without project registration or project identity.

tools.title: Add Manifest
tools.description: Creates an empty manifest from the existing project inventory shape.

tools.title: New World
tools.description: Creates a named world for this computer/user instance under .rab/worlds, using the shared memory and template owners.

tools.title: Add Signal
tools.description: Creates a signal folder's settings, contract and README from its template.

tools.title: Add World Manifest
tools.description: Creates an empty manifest.json in an existing folder without project or beacon requirements.

tools.title: Audit Beacons
tools.description: Read-only current-format check of beacon records at an explicit beacon root.

tools.title: Audit Signals
tools.description: Read-only current-format check of signal settings and contracts at an explicit beacon root.

tools.title: Export World Snapshot
tools.description: Reads world records and tool catalog into a portable snapshot for read-only viewers.

tools.title: Create Folder Beacon
tools.description: Creates beacon.json in a project-relative folder for an updater to discover.

tools.title: World Scanner
tools.description: Indexes beacons and child signals under an explicit root and toolkit paths registered in world settings.

tools.title: Count Search Use
tools.description: Increment the used counter for a returned World Search item.

tools.title: World Watcher
tools.description: Saves a watcher file that watches only registered beacons; no watcher starts automatically.

tools.title: World Hands
tools.description: Returns the available hands owned by this world toolkit and their input contracts through Box discovery.

tools.title: World Search
tools.description: Search enabled beacon manifests in parallel, returning matches in beacon priority order.

manifests.title: Base
